purpose: Column header cell within a table-header that labels a column and optionally triggers sort changes when sortable.
useWhen: Labeling a column inside a table-header row.
Making a column user-sortable by setting the sortable prop and supplying a column identifier.
Sizing a fit table's column: sizing="content" for a short value such as a badge, sizing="fill" for prose.

avoidWhen.reason: Rendering a body data cell — use table-cell instead.
